title: Spiced Ethiopian Collard Greens
description: A flavorful and nutritious side dish made with lightly spiced Ethiopian collard greens. This recipe is a twist on the traditional Ethiopian gomen besega.
instructions: 1. Rinse the collard greens and remove the stems.
2. Chop the onion and mince the garlic and ginger.
3. Heat the niter kibbeh or vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
4. Add the onion and sauté until lightly browned.
5. Add the garlic and ginger and sauté for an additional 2 minutes.
6. Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the pan and sauté for 1 minute.
7. Add the chopped collard greens to the pan and sauté until wilted.
8. Stir in the beeswax or niter and continue to cook for an additional 5 minutes.
9. Serve the spiced collard greens hot.
10. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
